name: Bananas in Pyjamas
description: Bananas in Pyjamas is an Australian children's television show that premiered on 20 July 1992 on ABC. It has since become syndicated in many different countries, and dubbed into other languages. In the United States, the "Pyjamas" in the title was modified to reflect the American spelling pajamas. This aired in syndication from 1995 to 1997 as a half-hour series, then became a 15-minute show paired with a short-lived 15-minute series The Crayon Box, under a 30-minute block produced by Sachs Family Entertainment titled Bananas in Pajamas & The Crayon Box. Additionally, the characters and a scene from the show were featured in the Kids for Character sequel titled Kids for Character: Choices Count. The pilot episode was Pink Mug.

videos.title: Fun Time
videos.overview: It's fun time at Cuddles Avenue! Join the Bananas in Pyjamas and their friends, the Teddies and Rat in a Hat, as they organise fun games for everyone to play! There's a cowboy party, a puppet show, tales of great adventures and lots of dress ups!

videos.title: Singing Time
videos.overview: Sing and dance with the Bananas in Pyjamas and their friends to well loved rhymes and some favourites. Featuring Head and Shoulders, Humpty Dumpty, I'm a Little Teapot, Hickory Dickory Dock, It's Raining, It's Pouring and many more...

videos.title: Rock-a-Bye Bananas
videos.overview: The Bananas buy a hammock from Rat's shop without really knowing how to use it. After various futile attempts to get in it, they end up giving the hammock to the Teddies to use as a volleyball net.

videos.title: Pink Mug
videos.overview: The pink mug is Morgan's favourite but it is also Amy's favourite mug... When the mug gets broken the "Fix It" Bananas step in.

videos.title: Moon Rocket
videos.overview: Morgan is building a spaceship so that he can fly to the moon. When he disappears from the park Amy and Lulu think that he has gone to the moon without saying goodbye.

videos.title: Night Fright
videos.overview: The Bananas and Teddies decide to camp overnight in the Teddies' backyard. The Bananas scare the Teddies with strange noises.

videos.title: Hide and Seek
videos.overview: It's raining outside so the Bananas and Teddies decide to play hide and seek inside. The Teddies hide and the Bananas look for them.

videos.title: See Saw
videos.overview: Lulu and the Bananas make a see saw in the park, but they have some problems balancing the saw.

videos.title: Grumpy Wumpy
videos.overview: The Teddies have to clear autumn leaves from the park, but Morgan has woken up in a grumpy mood. The Bananas decide to help the Teddies and to cheer up Morgan.

videos.title: Paper Chase
videos.overview: It's a windy day and the beach is filled with newspaper. The Bananas start to clean up, wondering who is the litterbug.

videos.title: The Storm
videos.overview: One night there is a storm and the Bananas and Teddies are a bit scared. Morgan gets trapped in his room.

videos.title: The Parcel
videos.overview: A very large box arrives at the Bananas house. It's a present for the Teddies. The Bananas and Teddies struggle to move the very large box through the Teddies door.

videos.title: The Robot
videos.overview: It is Morgan's turn to clean the Teddies house so he has no time to play outside: The Bananas plan a "trick time" and dress Lulu up as a Robot.

videos.title: Happy Holiday
videos.overview: The Teddies and Bananas are going on a holiday. Everyone goes home to pack but Morgan just wants to play for a little longer in the park.

videos.title: Decorating
videos.overview: The Bananas in Pyjamas decide to decorate their house with some new wallpaper. The Teddies help too. Sticky, messy fun for everyone!

videos.title: It's Raining
videos.overview: The Teddies have run out of munchy honey cakes and so Morgan wants to go out and get some, but it's raining outside.

videos.title: Doctor Bananas
videos.overview: Morgan hurts his arm playing on the beach. Luckily the "Doctor Bananas" are nearby and come to the rescue.

videos.title: Banana's Birthday Monday
videos.overview: The Bananas buy presents for each other - their birthday is on the same day - Friday. The Teddies plan a surprise party for the Bananas.

videos.title: Banana's Birthday Tuesday
videos.overview: The Bananas wrap up their presents for each other. Morgan decides to make a birthday cake for the Bananas. Unfortunately Amy decides to help.

videos.title: Banana's Birthday Wednesday
videos.overview: The preparations continue: Lulu fills party bags, Morgan organises games. The Teddies act very strangely when the Bananas visit.

videos.title: Banana's Birthday Thursday
videos.overview: The Bananas wrap up their presents for each other. Morgan decides to make a birthday cake for the Bananas. Unfortunately Amy decides to help.

videos.title: Banana's Birthday Friday
videos.overview: It's Friday - the Bananas' birthday! The Teddies prepare their surprise party in the park. The Bananas are ready for their party at home...

videos.title: The Spider
videos.overview: Amy finds a spider in the park, she tries to introduce the spider to Morgan but Morgan is scared of spiders. The spider gets lost inside the Teddies' house.

videos.title: Amy's Castle
videos.overview: Amy is trying to build a big castle out of blocks. Unfortunately she always seems to be in the way and the castle keeps being knocked down.

videos.title: Show Business
videos.overview: The Bananas have a cold and are miserable so the Teddies decide to put on a show. The show is a disaster but the Bananas laugh so much they feel better.

videos.title: Getting Rythym
videos.overview: The Bananas find a broken guitar and an old fishing rod while cleaning up the beach. They plan a "Fix It" time.

videos.title: Musical Stairs
videos.overview: The Bananas' stairs are squeaking. They decide it's "Music Time" and use the stairs to play a simple tune.

videos.title: Swamp Lake
videos.overview: Lulu tries unsuccessfully to teach a new dance to Morgan and the Bananas. Amy shows her how much easier it is to dance with a broom in your hand.

videos.title: Take One
videos.overview: Amy uses her new tape recorder to record a song the Teddies and Bananas have created together.

videos.title: Video Clip
videos.overview: The Teddies dress up in special costumes to make a video clip for their song. They visit the Bananas who have decorated their house just like a disco!

videos.title: Cuddles Avenue
videos.overview: We meet the Teddies, Amy, Morgan and Lulu and the Bananas: B.1 and B.2 The Bananas play a trick on the Teddies by knocking on their door and then hiding.

videos.title: Fancy Dress
videos.overview: The Bananas and Teddies have been invited to a fancy dress party. The Bananas haven't got any costumes to wear so the Teddies decide to help out...

videos.title: Chasing Rainbows
videos.overview: The Bananas see a rainbow on the beach and decide to search for the pot of gold that is at the end of every rainbow - but rainbows are hard to catch!

videos.title: Something Fishy
videos.overview: Lulu spends the day fishing but doesn't catch a single fish. The Bananas have caught a whole basket full of fish. They give Lulu a fishing lesson.

videos.title: Lulu's Magic
videos.overview: Lulu has a new magic set. She practices all day and then puts on a magic show. Morgan is jealous and keeps trying to spoil the fun.

videos.title: Obstacle Race
videos.overview: Lulu organises an obstacle race in the park. The others are not very enthusiastic so Lulu gives them a head start.

videos.title: Ready, Steady, Go!
videos.overview: The Teddies and Bananas have lots of fun taking part in three legged, egg and spoon and sack races. And best of all - everyone wins!

videos.title: Where's Lulu?
videos.overview: Lulu can't find her sun hat and umbrella, and is late for the picnic. Then she can't find the picnic. There is much confusion and running around as everyone goes in circles trying to find each other!

videos.title: Story Time
videos.overview: The Bananas are reading a story and stop half way through: planning to finish it the next morning then read it to the Teddies. The book disappears, but they tell the Teddies by acting it out. But they can only tell half of the story.

videos.title: Rat Hotel
videos.overview: Rat has gone into the accommodation business turning his shop into a hotel. The problem is, he only has one room: his own, and he only has one staff member... himself!

videos.title: Rock-A-Bye-Bananas
videos.overview: The Bananas buy a hammock from Rat's shop without really knowing how to use it. After various futile attempts to get in it, they end up giving the hammock to the Teddies to use as a volleyball net.

videos.title: Cock-A-Doodle
videos.overview: Rat is having trouble with his internal clock, sleeping in when he should be up and in his shop. He decides that he needs to get a rooster and the Bananas decide to help him. It's rooster time!

videos.title: Radio Bananas
videos.overview: Rat has set up a radio station in Cuddles Avenue. He invites the Bananas to take over while he has a break and chaos ensues. The Bananas play the wrong music, give the wrong weather report but end up creating a popular song by mistake

videos.title: Bananas Without Pyjamas
videos.overview: The Bananas decide to wash every set of pyjamas they own at the one time, leaving them with nothing to wear. They hide from the others while waiting for the pyjamas to dry only to find that they have disappeared from the clothesline.

videos.title: The Flag
videos.overview: Rat donates a flagpole to Cuddles Avenue but in the excitement forgets to get a flag. The Bananas decide to surprise rat and run off to make a Banana flag. The problem is that the Teddies and Rat also make flags

videos.title: Hat Trouble
videos.overview: It's Silly Hat Day and the Bananas and Teddies are going to a picnic wearing hats that Rat made. The hats all have problems. B1's hat doesn't fit, B2's hat blocks his ears, Morgan's makes him sneeze and Lulu and Amy's cover their eyes.

videos.title: Home Time Rat
videos.overview: The Teddies have a dinner party. It's getting late and Rat just won't leave… he has one boring story after another. The Bananas come to the Teddies' rescue by laying a cheese trail in an attempt to lure Rat out and home.

videos.title: Magic Tolstoy
videos.overview: The Bananas think Tolstoy has magic powers, as they think they see him in 2 places at the same time. In fact they see 2 different tortoises, the other one being Thomasina, Tolstoys new friend.

videos.title: Tortoise Wedding
videos.overview: Tolstoy and Thomasina are getting married, with B1 and B2 as Best Bananas. When the big day arrives, B1 & B2 spend the whole time worrying that something may go wrong. Nothing does until the end when they sit on their top hats.

videos.title: Banana Breakfast
videos.overview: The Bananas decide to surprise the Teddies by making them breakfast in bed. Their plans come unstuck when they accidentally spill the breakfast on the Teddies instead of serving it.

videos.title: Sneezing Time
videos.overview: Amy buys a new red jumper from Rat's shop, unaware that he has spilt pepper on it. When she shows it to the others, they all start to sneeze. Amy thinks she's the cause but the Bananas find the true reason for all the sneezing.

videos.title: Stepping On Cracks
videos.overview: The Bananas and Teddies are avoiding stepping on cracks. Amy steps on one but continues to play. One by one, they all get eliminated except for Amy. When she finds she has won, she admits to her mistake, and gives the prize to Morgan.

videos.title: Stuck Inside
videos.overview: The Teddies are stuck inside when both their front and back doors jam. The Bananas' rescue attempt fails and in the process the Bananas end up stuck inside with the Teddies. Rat saves the day and frees the trapped occupants.

videos.title: Bedtime Bunyip
videos.overview: The Bananas are reading a story about a bunyip and hear some strange noises. They think a real bunyip has come to visit. They search for the bunyip but in the end find that it was Tolstoy making the noises

videos.title: Speedy Bananas
videos.overview: Rat boasts about his prowess on the sporting field so Lulu challenges him to a running race with B1. During the race, Lulu and the Bananas play a trick on Rat by disguising B2 as B1 and substituting him during the race.

videos.title: Home Video
videos.overview: Rat decides to make a home video of life in Cuddles Avenue. He enlists the help of the Bananas and the Teddies but has a frustrating time. The Bananas can't even get the tripod to work and the Teddies get starry eyes.

videos.title: Lulu's Yo-Yo
videos.overview: Amy and Morgan buy new Yo Yo's from Rat's shop. When LuLu goes to buy one, Rat has run out of them. The Bananas offer to make LuLu a YoYo. It is not as easy as they thought and in the process end up making a diabolo.

videos.title: Perfect Fit
videos.overview: The Bananas want to buy one of Morgan's paintings to hang on their wall. First they have to work out how to measure the space and choose a painting of the right size.

videos.title: Lost Key
videos.overview: The Bananas find a key outside their house. They search unsuccessfully for a lock to match the key, and throw the key away - then realise it was for their front door.

videos.title: Copycat Bananas
videos.overview: The Bananas trick the Teddies by copying everything they do. But Lulu tricks the Bananas back by asking them to copy things they can't do.

videos.title: Footprints
videos.overview: The Bananas find strange footprints in the sand and decide to track them. The Teddies join in. Gradually they come to believe that the tracks were made by a monster.

videos.title: Star Bananas
videos.overview: Rat decides to make a film - Jungle Rat - in which he is to be the hero. But the Banana camera crew end up staging the rescue and starring in the show themselves.

videos.title: Hide and Sleep
videos.overview: The Bananas are trying to complete their first jigsaw puzzle. The Teddies visit for a game of hide and seek. However, the Bananas are distracted by the jigsaw.

videos.title: Lost and Found
videos.overview: Lulu loses her bracelet while playing on the beach. The Bananas look for it, and find all sorts of things that they've lost, but not Lulu's bracelet.

videos.title: Busy Day
videos.overview: Rat has a lot to do this day but he can't do anything until he finds his "To Do" list. The Bananas help Rat look for his list and end up doing all his chores for him.

videos.title: Fool's Gold
videos.overview: Amy's excited because she thinks she's found a gold nugget in the creek. She gives it to Rat in exchange for gold panning equipment, but she can't find any more gold.

videos.title: Waiter Bananas
videos.overview: Cafe Rat is ready for business, but Rat is too busy cooking to serve the customers. The Bananas help out as waiters, mixing up the orders as they go!

videos.title: Big Cheese
videos.overview: Rat advertises a rock concert starring Elton Rat and the Big Cheese Band. When Elton Rat fails to show, Rat and the Bananas have to be the Big Cheese Band themselves.

videos.title: Teddy Friends
videos.overview: When the Bananas come to Rat's shop to buy each other a present, the Teddies play a trick on the Bananas and Lulu and Amy pretend to be Teddy Friend Robots.

videos.title: Atchoo Birds
videos.overview: Morgan and Amy want to find a mysterious and rare bird. Not far away, the Bananas are sneezing, and the Teddies think they've found a genuine atchoo bird!

videos.title: Three-Legged Bananas
videos.overview: The Bananas are learning to tie their shoelaces. They end up tying them to each other so they decide to have a three legged race with the Teddies.

videos.title: Morgan's Mail
videos.overview: Morgan complains that he never gets any mail. He decides to write to the Bananas but their reply gets lost. Tolstoy finds it and delivers it to Morgan, just in time.

videos.title: Fixit Rat
videos.overview: Rat is offering a new 'Fixit' service - good as new, guaranteed! The Bananas and Teddies bring him all their things that need mending. Rat doesn't know where to begin!

videos.title: Giant Opera
videos.overview: Lulu is putting on an opera about two Merry Yellow Giants. The Bananas get ready for the opera and put on their giant costumes but find they can't fit out the door.

videos.title: Yippy Chippy
videos.overview: The Bananas and Teddies buy lots of packets of 'Yippy Chips' to collect the special cards inside. But Rat has left out the vital card needed to complete the set!

videos.title: Desert Island
videos.overview: It's too noisy for Amy at home and she decides she would rather live on a desert island. She builds a hut on the beach, but soon the others come looking for her.

videos.title: News Flash
videos.overview: Rat has set up the Cuddles Avenue Radio station in his shop. Only problem is, there's nothing happening to put on the news. So he decides to make up some stories!

videos.title: Crowded House
videos.overview: Rat has too many things in his bedroom and he can't find anything. The Bananas invite him to stay at their house, but it's not as peaceful as Rat would like!

videos.title: Super Sale
videos.overview: Lulu organises a Super Sale to help Rat get rid of all the excess stock in his shop. When Rat sees all the crazy bargains, he can't resist buying them all himself!

videos.title: Happy Camper
videos.overview: Rat takes a camping holiday at the beach, but he has forgotten to bring half his things and has to keep popping back to get them!

videos.title: Wonderful Cake
videos.overview: Rat has made an cake for Morgan's birthday. Unfortunately it keeps meeting with accidents and gets squashed. The Bananas come up with their own indestructible cake.

videos.title: Rat World
videos.overview: Rat opens his own theme park in which he is the star. But he finds out that giving the Teddy and Bananas customers a cheesy good time is not all fun.

videos.title: Lulu's Doovers
videos.overview: When Rat sees Lulu picking up leaves with a special gadget, he decides to sell them in his shop. The Bananas soon find that they're more trouble than they're worth!

videos.title: Amy's News
videos.overview: Amy is disappointed that her photo isn't in the Cuddles Avenue Newspaper. The Bananas help by following her around with a camera, in case she does anything exciting.

videos.title: Full Load
videos.overview: The Bananas are having a hard time carrying their shopping and groceries back from Rat's shop. It gets harder when Lulu and Amy ask them to carry more things for them.

videos.title: Garden Gnomes
videos.overview: Lulu has bought two garden gnomes from Rat's shop and Rat asks the Bananas to deliver them. The gnomes get broken on the way and the Bananas can't repair them!

videos.title: Street Stalls
videos.overview: The Bananas can't think of anything to sell at the Cuddles Avenue Street Fair. So they pitch in and help everybody else and end up helping Rat sell his Ratburgers.

videos.title: Drip Splosh
videos.overview: B1 can't get to sleep because of a loud dripping tap. He calls Plumber Rat to help fix it. Rat calls the Teddies, but no one can work out how to stop the tap dripping.

videos.title: Perfect Present
videos.overview: It's Lulu's birthday. The Bananas want to buy her the perfect present, but everything they want to give her, she's already got, or someone else is already getting!

videos.title: Ticklish Problem
videos.overview: The Bananas promise themselves that they will finish dusting before they can play. They get distracted when the Teddies come over and lose their feather dusters.

videos.title: Guessing Game
videos.overview: Rat in a Hat is running a competition to attract customers to his shop; whoever guesses how many beans are in the jar wins. Everyone wants to win, especially Rat!

videos.title: Beat Box
videos.overview: The Teddies are having a party and Morgan is in charge of the music. He buys a special "Beat Box" from Rat. The problem is it doesn't sound like party music at all!

videos.title: Horse and Cart
videos.overview: Rat devises a very special horse and cart ride for a tour around Cuddles Avenue for Lulu and Amy, in his converted Ratmobile pulled by two very unsusual horses.

videos.title: Night Visitors
videos.overview: Rat wants to throw out some clothes, but his rubbish bin is full, so he hides them instead. The Bananas find them and Rat says they were left by night visitors.

videos.title: Backstage Bananas
videos.overview: The Teddies are putting on a new play, and Lulu gets the Bananas to help backstage. The rehearsal goes well, but on opening night, things don't run so smoothly.

videos.title: Next, Please
videos.overview: Morgan takes Amy to Rat's clinic after she knocks her head on a tree. The Doctor Bananas, assisted by Nurse Rat, are also trying to help Lulu's sore finger.

videos.title: Princess Lulu
videos.overview: Lulu wishes she was a princess, when Amy and Morgan fail to notice her beautiful new dress. The Bananas play along and introduce her to Rat as the Princess Lulu.

videos.title: Rescue Rumba
videos.overview: The Teddies want to surprise the Bananas with their new dance "The Jelly Rumba". They ask them to come over for a "big surprise". The Bananas see the Teddies waving their arms around and shouting and think they're stuck the house.

videos.title: Flash the Fish
videos.overview: The Bananas think it will be easy to look after the new pet Flash the Fish. When they get him home, they realise they've got nowhere to put him!

videos.title: Walk the Fish
videos.overview: The Bananas think their new pet Flash the Fish would like to see Cuddles Avenue, so they take him for a walk. But Flash accidentally ends up in the park pond!

videos.title: Too Many Tomatoes
videos.overview: When Rat has a tomato plant sale, the Bananas decide to buy the lot, because 'you can never have too many tomatoes' - but soon find out that maybe you can!

videos.title: Quiz Show
videos.overview: Rat holds a quiz to find out who is the 'Brains of Cuddles Avenue'. The prize is the world's most delicious icecream cake and everyone is keen to win, especially Rat!

videos.title: Pump Pumpkin
videos.overview: Rat is desperate to win an award in the Cuddles Avenue Show. He secretly pumps up a balloon and paints it to win the award for the biggest pumpkin.

videos.title: Picnic Friends
videos.overview: The Bananas are having a picnic and wish they had some friends to share all their food. It's not long before Maggie, Tolstoy and the farm animals join them!

videos.title: Morgan's Photo
videos.overview: Morgan wants to take a photo for the cover of the Cuddles Avenue Newspaper. He is taking a photo of the Bananas knitting in the park when he spies Kevin the butterfly and runs off after him but he's tangled in the wool!

videos.title: All Aboard
videos.overview: Rat builds a train and train tracks to take everyone for rides around Cuddles Avenue. Unfortunately he forgets that to carry passengers, a train needs carriages.

videos.title: Ring, Ring
videos.overview: Rat asks the Bananas to take some photos for his photo exhibition. The Bananas go to the Teddies house, but whenever a photo opportunity occurs, they get distracted.

videos.title: Cold Sheep
videos.overview: The Bananas are horrified when they find Dolly has been shorn. How will she keep warm? The Bananas solve the problem by knitting her a warm jumper out of her own wool.

videos.title: Winged Heels
videos.overview: Amy and Morgan have lots of jobs to do and wish they could go faster The Wish Fairy Bananas attach wings to Amy's shoes and Morgan's scooter to help them.

videos.title: Egg Collector
videos.overview: Peck has suddenly stopped laying eggs, causing a crisis in Cuddles Avenue. The Bananas investigate and find that Rat is responsible for the mystery.

videos.title: Scaresheep
videos.overview: Lulu and Amy are trying to grow vegetables but Dolly the sheep keeps eating them. The Bananas build a 'scaresheep' to keep Dolly from eating the vegetables.

videos.title: Farm Fresh
videos.overview: When the shop runs out of breakfast things, the Bananas have to go to the farm to collect some fresh supplies. They collect the eggs, get the milk and the oranges!

videos.title: No Speaking Day
videos.overview: The Teddies are making too much noise, so Lulu decides they should make it "No Speaking Day" so they can have a bit of peace and quiet.

videos.title: Animal Hospital
videos.overview: The Vet Bananas look after the sick animals, Maggie, Tolstoy and Dolly. It's a lot of work and the animals keep the Bananas awake most of the night!

videos.title: Barnyard Choir
videos.overview: Everyone is finding it difficult to cope with the noise made by the animals on the farm. The Bananas solve the problem by teaching the animals to sing in tune.

videos.title: Farm Show
videos.overview: The Bananas are getting the animals ready for show day at the Farm. Morgan is arranging his display of cakes, and Amy and Lulu arrange the flowers and vegetables.

videos.title: Pig's Company
videos.overview: Pedro the pig is off his food. The Bananas try many ways to cheer him up, without success. Rat solves the problem by showing that pigs like company when they eat.

videos.title: Jungle Amy
videos.overview: Amy wants to play the game Jungle Amy, but Morgan and Lulu are too busy to play with her. She isn't having much fun playing on her own, so the Bananas join in the game.

videos.title: Cold Comfort
videos.overview: It's a freezing cold day at the Cuddles Avenue Farm. After their jobs, everyone goes home - but the Bananas and Amy worry that the animals will be freezing!

videos.title: Everybody Welcome
videos.overview: The Bananas offer to help Lulu invite everybody to the big barn dance at the farm. They ask the tortoises, Maggie and the farm animals but forget to ask Rat.

videos.title: Nighty Day
videos.overview: The Bananas forget to set their alarm, and sleep the whole day. It's night time when they wake up but the Bananas can't understand why it's dark and everyone is sleepy.

videos.title: Rat's Farm
videos.overview: The Bananas are in a hurry one day when they call into Rat's shop - they want to get all their farm jobs done quickly so they can go sailing with the Teddies!

videos.title: Cheese Trees
videos.overview: The Bananas want to buy some cheese from Rat in a Hat's shop. But he's run out! The Bananas say they'll get him some cheese, and set off looking for a cheese tree.

videos.title: Farm Adventures
videos.overview: The Bananas are cleaning up the farm and getting the animals ready for Rat's Farm Adventure Tour, but they accidentally let the animals escape!

videos.title: Hungry Harvest
videos.overview: The wheat on the Cuddles Avenue farm is finally ready for harvest. Everyone works hard to bring it in, thinking of all the lovely cakes and bread they will have!

videos.title: Cut-Out Bananas
videos.overview: It's a very busy day for the Bananas - they've promised to help Lulu in the park and Morgan and Amy at the farm. So they make some cut-out Bananas to help them!

videos.title: Mooving Cow
videos.overview: Lulu is trying to move Camembert into the barn before it starts to pour with rain, but Camembert won't budge. Everyone tries their own plan to get things moving.

videos.title: Tortoise Trek
videos.overview: The Bananas are helping Tolstoy and Thomasina on their walk to the pond, as there are a number of obstacles to clear. They come up with some ingenious solutions!

videos.title: Bed Rest
videos.overview: The Bananas aren't feeling well so they call on the Doctor Teddies who tell them to stay in bed. When the Bananas get hungry, they call on Rat's home delivery service.

videos.title: Handy Bananas
videos.overview: The Bananas want to make the same table that the Teddies have built using a manual from Rat in a Hat's shop. But Rat drops the manual and the pages get muddled up.

videos.title: Mayor Rat
videos.overview: Rat is reading his favourite book 'Great Rats in History' and comes across Mayor Augustus Rat. Rat is very impressed and decides that Cuddles Avenue needs a mayor.

videos.title: Sheepdog Bananas
videos.overview: The Bananas leave the farm gate open and Dolly the sheep escapes. They decide to become Sheepdog Bananas and chase Dolly all around town.

videos.title: Sir Knight Rat
videos.overview: Rat falls asleep reading a fairy story and dreams that he is Sir Knight Rat on a quest to rescue a fair princess and return her to the king to win the reward!

videos.title: Dancing Daze
videos.overview: Everyone is excited about the Cuddles Avenue Ball - everyone that is, except Rat. Lulu discovers that the reason Rat doesn't like balls is because he can't dance!

videos.title: Noisy Cow
videos.overview: The Bananas trick Rat and the Teddies into believing that Camembert can make all sorts of noises. The Bananas get stuck in the barn and the Teddies have to rescue them.

videos.title: Big Clean Up
videos.overview: Everyone has been so busy that the Cuddles Avenue Farm has become a terrible mess. The Bananas want to surprise the Teddies and Rat by giving the farm a big clean up.

videos.title: 2-Wheeler Bananas
videos.overview: Amy decides it's time to ride her bike without trainer wheels, but she falls off. The Bananas encourage her to keep trying and she soon gets the hang of it.

videos.title: Where's Lulu?
videos.overview: Lulu can't find her sun hat and umbrella, and is late for the picnic. Then she can't find the picnic. There is much confusion and running around as everyone goes in circles trying to find each other!
